_about: Shared with the Blocofy CLI: every implementation of the XLIFF dialect must accept `accept` and refuse `reject` (bodies go into `envelope` at {{BODY}}; {{FILE_EXTRA}} is empty) and every entry of `documents`.
envelope:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<xliff version="1.2" xmlns="urn:oasis:names:tc:xliff:document:1.2" xmlns:bf="https://blocofy.com/ns/translation/1">
  <file original="blocofy" datatype="plaintext" source-language="tr-TR" target-language="en-US"{{FILE_EXTRA}}>
    <body>{{BODY}}</body>
  </file>
</xliff>

accept.name: a double-escaped ampersand is one level only
a literal CRLF is a newline
a comment outside text is ignored
a comment inside text is dropped

reject.name: bare ampersand followed by a space
upper-case AMP is not an XML entity
stray equals signs in a tag

documents.name: DOCTYPE with an entity
documents.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE xliff [<!ENTITY a "b">]>
<xliff version="1.2" xmlns="urn:oasis:names:tc:xliff:document:1.2" xmlns:bf="https://blocofy.com/ns/translation/1">
  <file original="blocofy" datatype="plaintext" source-language="tr-TR" target-language="en-US">
    <body></body>
  </file>
</xliff>

<!DOCTYPE xliff [<!ENTITY e "x">]><!-- -->

  <file original="blocofy" datatype="plaintext" source-language="tr-TR" target-language="en-US">
    <body><trans-unit id="settings:a" foo="<!--"><source>&e;</source><target bar="-->">y</target></trans-unit></body>
  </file>
</xliff>
